metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about fire detections in Brazil comparing 2019 vs 2007. I need to: 1. Use a fire detection dataset - MODIS active fire products would be appropriate (MODIS/006/MCD14ML for thermal anomalies/fire hotspots) 2. Define Brazil geometry and the two time periods (2007 and 2019) 3. Count fire detections in each year 4. Compare the counts to determine if 2019 had fewer than 2007 For fire detection data, I can use: - MODIS Collection 6 Active Fire product (MODIS/006/MCD14ML) - Or FIRMS data if available Let me structure this: 1. Get Brazil boundary 2. Get fire data for 2007 and 2019 3. Count fire detections in each year 4. Compare and output answer I need to handle cases where no data is available for either year. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil')); const date2007 = ['2007-01-01', '2007-12-31']; const date2019 = ['2019-01-01', '2019-12-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Data const fires2007 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterBounds(brazil) .filterDate(date2007[0], date2007[1]); const fires2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterBounds(brazil) .filterDate(date2019[0], date2019[1]); // Check collection sizes const count2007 = fires2007.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = fires2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2007 Fire Images: ${count2007}`); console.log(`2019 Fire Images: ${count2019}`); if (count2007 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Count fire detections - use 'confidence' band to count fire pixels // Fire pixels have confidence > 0 const countFires2007 = fires2007 .map(function(image) { return image.select('confidence').gt(0); }) .sum() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('confidence').getInfo(); const countFires2019 = fires2019 .map(function(image) { return image.select('confidence').gt(0); }) .sum() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('confidence').getInfo(); console.log(`2007 Fire Count: ${Math.round(countFires2007)}`); console.log(`2019 Fire Count: ${Math.round(countFires2019)}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (countFires2007 === null || countFires2019 === null || isNaN(countFires2007) || isNaN(countFires2019)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (countFires2019 < countFires2007) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
